item.title: The Bytes Moved, the Compute Didn't: Ten Years of Path Dependence in Decentralized Databases
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the field’s unsolved problem is not that consensus is too weak, it is that compute never followed the bytes. A database is not one thing — it is four: write order, byte location, execution location, read permission. Six routes, and each one bought exactly one of them.
